summary: Phase 11 full-stack testing — League Premium (Stripe) + Personalized Recommendations + Payment success/cancel pages. 16/16 backend tests passed. Frontend: all critical flows working — RecommendedForYou renders on dashboard with 3 chip groups, chip interaction re-ranks leagues (Frozen Dynasty promoted to TOP PICK on Hardcore+Auction), Premium tab renders 6 feature cards + $29.99 upgrade button, Stripe checkout redirect works (captured real test URL), /payment/cancel renders correctly, /payment/success?session_id=INVALID shows polling state. 5 demo leagues regression passed.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 when the underlying Stripe test session is not retrievable (emergentintegrations CheckoutError bubbles up unhandled). Should be caught and returned as 404 or {payment_status:'unknown'}. Frontend polling code handles it gracefully today, but 500s pollute logs and confuse ops.

When league_id points to a non-existent ObjectId that is still a valid 24-hex string, returns 404. If the caller passes a string that is not a valid ObjectId, FastAPI returns 500 from bson.errors.InvalidId instead of 400/422. Consider validating ObjectId before DB lookup.
match_score is computed twice per ranked league (in sort key and again in _format). For larger candidate sets this is wasted work. Minor perf nit.

issues: Text 'CONFIRMING PAYMEN[T]…' appears cut in console dump — verify the polling state UI is not truncated behind the sidebar on smaller viewports. Functional rendering is correct on 1920x1080.

action_items: Wrap get_checkout_status() call in /api/payments/status/{session_id} with try/except CheckoutError — return {payment_status:'unknown'} with 200 or a 404 instead of raw 500. This prevents success-page polling from spamming 500s in the backend log.
Validate ObjectId shape for input.league_id in /api/payments/create and /api/leagues/{id}/premium to return 400 instead of 500 on malformed IDs.
Minor: deduplicate match_score computation in recommendations endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has crossed 3344 lines — continuing to defer router split is increasing risk. Phase 11 added ~120 more lines of payment/recommendation logic in the same file. Split into /app/backend/routers/{payments,recommendations,leagues,auth}.py should be the next refactor.

LEAGUE_PREMIUM_FEATURES list is duplicated conceptually in the status handler (rebuilt inline as [f['id'] for f in LEAGUE_PREMIUM_FEATURES]) — fine, but if a new feature is ever added, the activity-feed log message still says 'Premium features unlocked for this league' which is static. OK for now, but consider templating.

commitment_format_map in recommendations does not include any mapping for scoring_format='total_points' against commitment='casual'. 'best_ball' is in casual list which is correct. No bug, just worth documenting that scoring and draft weights are independent.

The status endpoint uses a strict `transaction['user_id'] != user['_id']` check — good — but does NOT consider league commissioner. If a commissioner initiates the purchase but another admin opens the success URL (shared over Slack), they'll get 403. Consider allowing commissioner or admin override.
No idempotency key / de-dupe on payment_transactions.session_id uniqueness. A retry-on-error could insert two rows with the same session_id. Add a unique index on session_id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11 (premium + recommendations) is green. Stripe test key sk_test_emergent produces real cs_test_* URLs but subsequent get_checkout_status() calls 404 at Stripe — which the backend currently surfaces as a raw 500. The frontend polling on /payment/success tolerates this. 5 demo leagues confirmed: Ice Kings Head-to-Head (redraft/h2h), Stat Chasers Roto (redraft/roto), Frozen Dynasty (dynasty/h2h/auction — THIS is the one the recommendation ranker pins to top on hardcore+auction+h2h), Perennial Keepers (keeper/h2h), Set-and-Forget Best Ball (best_ball/total_points, 32 teams). rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failing feature. Two minor RCA notes: (1) 500 on payments/status when Stripe returns 'no such session' is caused by emergentintegrations.CheckoutError not being caught; reproduce by calling GET /api/payments/status/{any-cs_test_id-after-session-expires}. Mitigation: wrap stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status in try/except. (2) Recommendation's match_score is recomputed; harmless.
